metadata.title: SpaceX, Tesla, Meta, Nvidia, Netflix, AT&T, Super Micro, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX, Tesla, Meta, Nvidia, Netflix, AT&T, Super Micro, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stock futures rose Wednesday as investors awaited high-stakes reports from Meta Platforms and Tesla, following a series of strong corporate earnings.
